notes.title: Version 1.02 Live
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067967/f7ba8258b0a621f85144642dd291344015070ab5.png

New Storyline Added!

Shallow Shoal

Explore the desolate island of Shallow Shoal and uncover the secrets of its eternal darkness.

Massive Skill update

Added additional skill scaling for different skills.

Added mediation, rally, and new tiers of skills unlocked at different levels.

Mediation skills for restoring MP at the cost of health.

Changed and added new skills to different sellswords and the player.

New companions

Added a new cat companion, “Cheshire,” as a general supporter; they are a stowaway cat, so they show up on your ship.

Added "Lady Cathrine". You must obtain her Urn item as a drop in Shallow Shoal to unlock her.

Urn has a 5% chance to drop until episode 8, where it becomes 20%.

Rest in Cabin after having the Urn to unlock the new companion.

Enemy balancing

Balancing, “The Chain” boss for health and attacks

Changed "Will-O-Wisp" skills for easy fights

Send us Feedback

Use HERE to go to the survey or use this link "https://forms.gle/DPgzEM8pUuYz1b2A6" to go to the survey directly.

If we missed any thing comment below or shoot us a email at "officialqueenscourt@gmail.com".

notes.title: Version 1.01 Live
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067967/2ec3f6c5a364373035b6c204bb2115a32712914c.png

Verison 1.01 Update

- New Features -

Wildgrown Development shop: Purchase upgrades for passive income after completed “The Chain” storyline.

Updated Crescent Cup with new food and drink items.

- Bug Fixes -

Changes started gold from 5,000 to 0 for better leveling and gameplay

Better skill description.

Fixed enemy magic skills to allow them to fight.

Fixed adding Luna to crew, must replay mission to add her back if selected.

Fixed issues with episode 7 switch for the chain.

We couldn’t replicate a reported death error sound effect with certain enemies, if it pops up please report which enemy and what episode it was found in.

Changed Item Pricing.
